notes:
Improvements:

+ Improves Guljaj channel-name parsing so the real website names are shown instead of generic Guljaj ID labels, even when the same channel ID appears multiple times in the catalog HTML.

+ Adds warm-up retries for initially empty Guljaj live HLS playlists, skips duplicate Player 1-4 stream URLs, and falls back to the public Free player when the logged-in live stream has no playable media segments.

Bugfixes:

- Fixes the Guljaj status-check flow returning an invalid Settings directory after completion, which could throw the user out of Cumination.

- Removes the asynchronous Guljaj login-success notification from the Settings workflow so it no longer appears behind the Settings window.
